crossRefs.note: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

translations.web: They deck it with silver and with gold. They fasten it with nails and with hammers, so that it can’t move.
translations.bsb: They adorn it with silver and gold and fasten it with hammer and nails, so that it will not totter.
translations.kjv: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move
translations.asv: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
